about_the_game:
Key Features:

  • Idle Gameplay: Progress even when you're offline, with deep automation options for grinding and loot collection.

  • Endless Dungeons: Procedurally generated levels with ever-increasing challenges and rewards.

  • Legendary Loot: Hundreds of unique items to collect, craft, and upgrade, with endless build possibilities.

  • Epic Boss Battles: Face off against towering bosses with unique mechanics and devastating attacks.

  • Deep Progression: Unlock skills, upgrade abilities, and customize your hero with a sprawling talent tree.

  • Seasonal Events: Regular updates with new content, challenges, and rewards to keep the adventure fresh.

Are You Ready to Forge Your Legend?
Lootlands: Idle ARPG is the ultimate blend of action RPG depth and idle gameplay convenience. Whether you're a hardcore gamer or a casual player, there's always something new to discover, loot to collect, and challenges to conquer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2012 graphics or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes please

short_description: What if Path of Exile played itself? Lootlands is an idle ARPG where loot is everything. Build your hero, conquer endless dungeons, and collect god-tier gear. No grind required.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese
